## Unslop

Release 1.15 adds a deterministic Markdown prose linter to the Prek hook bundle.

- 25 explainable rules covering filler, canned phrases, rhetoric, repetition, rhythm, and formatting density
- Markdown-aware masking for code, URLs, front matter, comments, tables, quotations, and MDX tags
- recommended and strict presets
- JSON configuration and local suppression comments
- text, JSON, and GitHub annotation output
- no new runtime dependency
- coffee before/after calibration plus unit and published-hook tests

The linter judges writing patterns, not authorship. A single em dash or contrast is allowed; repeated use inside a short window is what normally triggers structural rules.
